* Decipher's errata changes only the lore: the Glossary strikes the word “hologram” (“Dejarik <s>hologram</s> of a Ng'ok war beast”). The game text is the printed card's. Bill ruled on 23 Nov 2026 that a lore-only errata is a real Decipher errata.
* Decipher's white-bordered Revised card [[Ng'ok (Revised)]] (September 1998) carries this errata's lore, but its game text says “deployed four or more characters to same location” where this errata and the original card say “at same location”, so it is not shown here as a card with this text. No black-bordered card has Decipher's exact words.

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher never printed a card with this wording.
